actions.action: Amend the current mix with perlite or orchid bark (about 1:2–3) for drainage
Slide the plant out and check the roots
If roots are mushy, brown or smelly, trim them and repot in fresh chunky mix
Check soil and water thoroughly only when the top 2–3 inches are dry
Empty the built-in tray after watering
Move the plant to bright indirect light
If moving outside, acclimate gradually over 1–2 weeks, using shade cloth
Trim off fully brown or crispy scorched leaves
If roots are healthy but the plant still declines, post photos of roots and new growth

reason: The answer blames sun scorch first and treats overwatering only as an aggravating factor, though it does recommend improving drainage and a conditional repot that overlap with the actual fix; nothing it suggests is likely to harm the plant.
